move.subject: SH-220: alternative commercial packages
move.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,
Thank you for your quotation. For 6,000 shafts annually over 24 months, please review these alternative packages:
A: EUR 11.36/unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
B: EUR 11.32/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
C: EUR 11.95/unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
The competing quotation offer:DEMO-C1-0 is EUR 16.00/unit for SH-220.
Please reconcile your price with the part should-cost benchmark cost:part:SH-220.
Please also address the delivery performance recorded in sc:DEMO-J1@2026Q3 in your proposed supply plan.
We can offer faster payment and allow 35 days for production against a sharper price. Please indicate which package works best and share your cost breakdown, including material, machining and overhead.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: SH-220: price and delivery alternatives
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your interest in establishing a long-term partnership. We are sourcing 6,000 shafts annually for 24 months. Please consider these alternative packages:
A: EUR 10.92/unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
B: EUR 10.85/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
C: EUR 11.52/unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
The demand forecast fc:SH-220@2026-09 should be reflected in your volume-based pricing.
Please address the quality performance recorded in sc:DEMO-C1@2026Q3 in your proposed production controls.
Your standard 45-day lead time cannot meet our requirement; please confirm 35 days in your revised offer. Faster payment is available against a lower price. Which package best suits your operation? Please provide the material, machining and overhead cost breakdown and explain any cost of shortening delivery.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for sharing the volume forecast and quality records; we have factored the volume into our pricing, and our team is implementing stricter production controls. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Meeting your 35-day lead time requirement incurs additional expedited production costs, which we can partially offset through 14-day payment terms. 

We therefore propose a revised price of €15.90 per unit based on the 35-day lead time and 14-day payment package. For our complete Angebot, we present a price of €15.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: SH-220: production planning and revised packages
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for confirming 35-day delivery and explaining the expedited production cost. The award volume available is 6,000 units per year over 24 months; I cannot offer a higher volume. Please base your revision on that full volume.
We increase our price proposal and retain 14-day payment. Please consider:
A: EUR 11.18/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
B: EUR 11.09/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW.
C: EUR 11.77/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Package B allows a longer production window instead of expedited production; please quantify the saving you can pass through. We do not require the premium 28-day service. Please identify the most competitive package and confirm your revised price on this volume basis.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: SH-220: revised proposal for your internal review
move.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,
Thank you for the substantial revision and the transparent breakdown. We recognise the material, labour and conversion requirements and appreciate your available capacity.
For your internal price review, we increase our proposal to EUR 11.73/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW, for 6,000 units annually over 24 months.
We retain the early payment you favour and the normal 35-day production window; no overtime or premium delivery is requested. This lets you plan the work around your existing machine loading. Please review the overhead and profit element against this regular workload and cash-flow package and return your revised quotation.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.body:

The comparison you requested is offer:DEMO-J1-1: EUR 14.70/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW for the same shaft.

move.body:

Our target is a commercial negotiating proposal, not a claim to know your internal margin or cost limit. We respect that these remain confidential.
We make a further price move and propose either:
A: EUR 12.06/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
B: EUR 12.65/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Both cover the same 6,000 units annually over 24 months, preserve early payment and require no premium delivery. Under B we offer a higher unit price for your arranging freight. Please review the two structures and return the best workable revision.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
